name: Retail and e-commerce

typical_workflows.name: Customer support
typical_workflows.description: Answer order, delivery, return and product questions by email, chat or social.

typical_workflows.name: Product listings
typical_workflows.description: Write product titles, descriptions and tags from supplier data.

typical_workflows.name: Review and feedback analysis
typical_workflows.description: Summarize customer reviews and spot recurring complaints.

typical_workflows.name: Inventory and reordering
typical_workflows.description: Decide what to restock and when.

typical_workflows.name: Returns and refunds handling
typical_workflows.description: Check return requests against policy and process them.

compliance_notes: Customer names, addresses and order history are personal data; privacy laws such as GDPR may apply if you sell to people in the EU.
Do not send full card numbers to any AI service; payment data should stay within your payment provider.
Product claims written by AI should be checked so they are accurate.
follow_up_questions: How many customer messages and orders do you handle per month?
What share of customer questions are repeats (where is my order, return policy)?
Which platform runs your store and your inbox?
Do you sell in the EU or UK?
